pipeline_construction_page.desc_p1: Solving this task frequently involves complications when laying main gas pipelines across roadways, water bodies, and rivers. Typically in such situations, the engineering design provides for trenchless pipeline installation via horizontal directional drilling (HDD), microtunneling, or auger boring.
pipeline_construction_page.desc_p2: We also possess proven engineering experience laying gas pipelines along the bed of water obstacles (without trenching) using the pulling method.
pipeline_construction_page.criteria_title: At the pre-project stage, the main criteria when selecting the route of the planned gas pipeline include:
pipeline_construction_page.criteria_item4: ensuring standard clearance distances from GDS and pipeline to existing structures and settlement boundaries
pipeline_construction_page.desc_p3: During engineering design, we evaluate alternative route alignments, taking into account GDS siting complexities and constrained environmental conditions.
pipeline_construction_page.desc_p4: The pipeline route is selected to minimize earthworks across hillside sections and reduce forest clearing to the minimum possible extent.
